_scenario: DLQ DEMO — Trigger intentional WMS fault then verify DLQ consolidation
_notes: Submit 3 copies of this order (incrementing orderId suffix each time) while the WMS mock is configured to return a SOAP Fault for any warehouseCode starting with 'WH-DLQ'. All 3 messages will exhaust retries and land in the dead-letter queue. The dlq-monitor workflow (15-min schedule) will then batch them into a single DLQ_ALERT_SUMMARY log event. Switch the mock back to SUCCESS mode and use the 'Resubmit from DLQ' pattern to manually re-process. Expected outcome: 3 DLQ entries visible in Service Bus Explorer; 1 DLQ_ALERT_SUMMARY event in Log Analytics; alert fires to Azure Monitor action group (if wired).
